svg.aria-label: KdlBeef parsing and writing throughput compared with other KDL libraries
svg.text: Parsing: average speed relative to KdlBeef
geometric mean over 6 inputs of each library's MB/s ÷ KdlBeef's · higher is better · KdlBeef = 1×
Writing a parsed document: average speed relative to KdlBeef
geometric mean of each library's MB/s of output ÷ KdlBeef's · libraries with a writer · higher is better
KdlBeef against the fastest alternative, per input
MB/s · for each input, the fastest other library that builds a document from it (or writes one) · bars scaled per input
* gokdl2 failed all but strings (its forced-KDL-2 streaming parse hits a buffer-refill bug; left out of its average).
* kdl-py did not finish HTML standard and HTML standard (compact) within 60 s (counted at that bound, which flatters it).
* zig-kdl failed UI markup, HTML standard and HTML standard (compact) (parse errors or a wrong node count; left out of its average).
* kdl-py (writing) did not finish HTML standard within 60 s (counted at that bound, which flatters it).
Linux x86-64, single thread · 1 s warm-up, then samples until 60% are within ±10% of their median · median of 3 processes · bench/compare
